# Expo React Native Review Checklist

This project currently uses this minimal mandatory gate:

1. No TypeScript errors.
2. No ESLint errors.
3. No hardcoded secrets.
4. Affected screens manually smoke-tested with expo start.
5. New behavior covered by tests where practical.

- .github/skills/stacks/expo-react-native/patterns.md
